text: In September 1942, an aircraft flying from Britain to Gibraltar crashed off Cádiz. Among the dead was a British courier carrying secret documents. His body washed up on the Spanish coast. When it was returned, his letter appeared unopened. But other evidence showed that material recovered in Spain was reaching the Germans.
